capabilities: Open files in a new tab by default
Switch to an already open tab instead of duplicating it
Open tabs as VS Code style previews
Choose where new tabs and tab groups are placed
disambiguation: Not a tab manager or session-saving tool; it only changes how Obsidian opens, focuses and places tabs.
extras: Works by patching Obsidian's internal methods; the README notes it should be compatible with most plugins and asks users to report incompatibilities, and warns that PDF++ can override its PDF opening behavior.
intentEvidence: adds a few improvements over Opener, including making non-file views such as the Graph View also open in new tabs
problem: Obsidian's default tab handling can replace the current note or open the same file twice, which is unfamiliar to people used to editors like VS Code.

relations.evidence: It is inspired by the Opener plugin which worked in a similar way, but is no longer maintained
make the plugins play nicely together by setting the "How to open..." options to "new tab"

summary: Settings panel that customizes how Obsidian opens and focuses tabs, covering new-tab defaults, preview tabs, duplicate prevention and tab placement.
